params.name: rangeObj
params.description: Cell range object where values/formatting/formulas will be pasted

params.name: dataObject
params.description: Object containing the cell data, formatting, and formulas to paste

sentinelValues.meaning: Pastes all data objects, including values, formatting, and formulas (default).

sentinelValues.value: vk clipboard options formulas and formatting
vk clipboard options value and formatting

overloads.semanticRole: The VP PASTE FROM OBJECT command pastes the contents, style and formulas stored in dataObject to the rangeObj object.

constraints: If rangeObj refers to more than one cell, only the first cell is used as the paste destination.
The paste options defined in the workbook options are taken into account in addition to the options parameter.
If options refers to a paste option not present in the copied dataObject (e.g. formulas), the command does nothing.
